name: br.com.neuralsystem/neural-system
title: Neural System
description: Find Neural System computer vision solutions and Windows apps, get prices and quotes, contact sales.

tools.name: search_neural
tools.description: Find which Neural System product solves a problem. Searches the computer vision solutions (camera analytics for safety, counting, retail, logistics, agribusiness, healthcare, mining…) and the Windows apps (file repair, data recovery, backup, photos, email, PDF, phone, disk…). Returns the best matches with links.

query.description: The user problem or need, in any language, e.g. "detect workers without helmet" or "recover a corrupted Excel file".

language.description: Answer language and currency: pt = Portuguese/BRL, en = English/USD, es = Spanish/USD.

tools.name: list_vision_solutions
tools.description: List the computer vision solutions by industry, with status (live, lab, on demand), monthly price per camera and page link.

segment.description: Optional industry id (e.g. industria, varejo, seguranca, logistica, agronegocio, saude, educacao, construcao-mineracao, energia, vendas-marketing).

language.description: Answer language and currency: pt = Portuguese/BRL, en = English/USD, es = Spanish/USD.

tools.name: get_vision_solution
tools.description: Details of one computer vision solution: what it detects, use cases, metrics, availability, price and links for demo and contact.

id.description: Solution id from search_neural or list_vision_solutions (e.g. epi, fluxo_pessoas, contagem_animais).

language.description: Answer language and currency: pt = Portuguese/BRL, en = English/USD, es = Spanish/USD.

tools.name: quote_vision
tools.description: Price estimate for the computer vision subscription: number of cameras and models per camera. Returns monthly fee, setup and volume discount. The final price is confirmed by the Neural team.

models.description: Solution ids to run on all cameras (e.g. ["epi","zona_de_risco"]).

language.description: Answer language and currency: pt = Portuguese/BRL, en = English/USD, es = Spanish/USD.

tools.name: list_desktop_apps
tools.description: List the Neural Windows apps with category, short description, availability and starting price.

language.description: Answer language and currency: pt = Portuguese/BRL, en = English/USD, es = Spanish/USD.

tools.name: get_desktop_app
tools.description: Details of one Windows app: what it does, plans and prices, FAQ, free download and the link where the user buys it (secure Stripe checkout on the app site).

id.description: App id from list_desktop_apps (e.g. repair, rescue, backup, photos, pdf).

language.description: Answer language and currency: pt = Portuguese/BRL, en = English/USD, es = Spanish/USD.

tools.name: request_contact
tools.description: Send the user's contact request to the Neural System sales team (demo, quote, free test with their own video). ONLY call after the user explicitly agreed to share their name and email with Neural System for this purpose. The user receives a confirmation email.

phone.description: Phone or WhatsApp with country code.

message.description: What the user needs: cameras, site, problem, timeline.

user_consent.description: true only if the user explicitly agreed to share this data with Neural System.

language.description: Answer language and currency: pt = Portuguese/BRL, en = English/USD, es = Spanish/USD.
